name: Madoka Childcare
description: Madoka Childcare — a block theme for a childcare centre for babies and toddlers of working parents in Dublin, founded in 2015. A hand-torn photograph frame opens the page; the care day sits on a torn sand band with soft time blobs and white label tabs; every heading sits on its own stripes. Albert Sans and Public Sans. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.

fonts.role: headings, labels, prices, time blobs (variable 100-900, Latin subset)

summary.en: A childcare centre for babies and toddlers: torn photograph frame, torn sand bands, blob photographs with white tabs and a care day set as time blobs.
